rca_of_issue: Approve/Extend 500 RCA: In _extend_subscription, the code compared `current` (naive datetime from MongoDB) with `now_utc()` (aware) BEFORE normalising tz. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/payments/{id}/approve -> TypeError 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Mitigation: normalise `current.tzinfo` to UTC prior to the comparison. Fixed and validated by re-running the two failing tests + full suite (21 pass).
